programme.title: American Visions
programme.desc: Robert Hughes considers how the Civil War industrialised society, bringing steam power, the Brooklyn Bridge, plutocrats and an urban underclass. Nostalgia for loss entered the culture and brought the Museum Age.

programme.title: Horizon
programme.sub-title: Tim Peake Special: How to Be an Astronaut
programme.desc: In December 2015, Tim Peake became Britain's first astronaut on board the International Space Station. For two years, he had been filming a video diary for Horizon as he prepared to leave. From family life to the rigorous training, this is an intimate portrait and remarkable insight into the world of an astronaut.

programme.title: Only Connect

programme.title: Chuck Berry in Concert
programme.desc: Legendary rock and roller Chuck Berry performs at the BBC Television Theatre in 1972. 'Johnny B Goode', 'Roll Over Beethoven' and 'Nadine' are just some of the highlights of this concert, shown in an extended cut. This version includes, for the first time, an epic rendition of 'My Ding-a-Ling' that carries all before it and raises innuendo to an art form.

programme.title: Tales of Rock'n'Roll: Heartbreak Hotel
programme.desc: A look at Elvis Presley's first million-selling release, 'Heartbreak Hotel'. In the process, tracks down the song's writers, schoolteacher Mae Axton and country musician Tommy Durden.

programme.title: Natural World
programme.desc: Welcome to the Penguin Post Office, a little bit of Britain in the heart of Antarctica. Inside, the post office has everything you'd expect. Outside, things are a little bit different. Neighbouring the post office are 3,000 gentoo penguins. They are there to raise a family, but their lives are far from picture postcard as adultery and robbery are rife.

programme.title: Making Life on Earth: Attenborough's Greatest Adventure
programme.desc: In 1976, David Attenborough embarked on his most ambitious project ever, "Life on Earth". No-one had ever attempted a natural history series on this scale before. This is the hair-raising story of how the first wildlife blockbuster was born.

programme.title: Life on Earth
programme.desc: The story of life, from the first primitive cells to the plants and animals that now live around us. David Attenborough goes on a world journey looking at the incredible variety of living things and fossils which throw light on the ancestry of life.

programme.title: Goolagong
programme.desc: Evonne Goolagong's Wimbledon debut prompts memories of her rise from Barellan to tennis stardom, while she struggles with the controlling behaviour of her coach Vic Edwards.

programme.title: Goolagong
programme.desc: Evonne navigates controversy, pressure and the fight for equal pay, while personal loss and burnout drive her to walk away from tennis at her peak.

programme.title: Scrublands
programme.desc: Disenchanted investigative journalist Martin Scarsden is told by his boss to write a follow-up piece a year after a mass shooting of five parishioners by a charismatic young priest in the small rural town of Riversend. The townsfolk do not look kindly on yet more intrusion into their still raw lives, but Scarsden begins to doubt the accepted version of events of that tragic day.

programme.title: Scrublands
programme.desc: Martin Scarsden decides to stay on in Riversend to dig deeper into the mystery of Byron Swift, a well-liked priest who suddenly murdered five of his parishioners.

programme.title: Keeping Up Appearances
programme.desc: Long-suffering Richard finds early retirement worrying, mainly because Hyacinth has lined up enough plans for his future to turn his twilight years into mishap-filled misery.

programme.title: Timeshift
programme.sub-title: The Trains That Time Forgot: Britain's Lost Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Timeshift journeys back to a lost era of rail travel, when trains had names, character and style. Once the pride of the railway companies that ran them, the named train is now largely consigned to railway history. Writer and presenter Andrew Martin asks why we once named trains and why we don't do so anymore. He embarks on three railway journeys around Britain, following the routes of three of the most famous named trains - the Flying Scotsman, the Cornish Riviera Express and the Brighton Belle.

programme.title: Michael Palin's Hemingway Adventure
programme.desc: Michael Palin continues to trace Hemingway's journey. He arrives in Key West in time for Hemingway's 100th birthday celebrations, where he is given boxing lessons from 83-year-old Shine Forbes who sparred with Hemingway. In Uganda, Michael has his hair cut en route up the Nile. At Butiaba, Uganda, he visits the site of a plane crash Hemingway was involved in. Finally, Michael reaches Venice in time for the carnival and then tries his hand at duck-hunting in nearby Caorle.

programme.title: Michael Palin's Hemingway Adventure
programme.desc: Michael Palin stays in Ernest Hemingway's favourite Cuban hotel and samples a few of his favourite hangouts including Bodeguita del Medio and the Floridita in Old Havana. Back in the American West, Michael attempts to be a cowboy and partakes in some male bonding while visiting Yellowstone Park. He also visits the house in Ketchum, Idaho where Hemingway died in 1961 and where he was laid to rest.

programme.title: Five to Eleven
programme.desc: Emma Thompson reads poetry and prose.

programme.title: Sondheim at the BBC
programme.desc: A celebration of the work of one of the great songwriters and lyricists, Stephen Sondheim, who passed away in November 2021 at the age of 91. A giant of musical theatre, Sondheim first found international fame in 1957 as the lyricist for Leonard Bernstein's 'West Side Story'.

programme.title: Britain's Most Fragile Treasure
programme.desc: Historian Dr Janina Ramirez unlocks the secrets of a centuries-old masterpiece in glass, the East Window at York Minster - the largest medieval stained-glass window in the country and the creative vision of a master craftsman called John Thornton. Within its 311 panels is the entire history of the world.

programme.desc: Hwyl a sbri i blant ifanc gyda'r blociau rhif. Fun and games for young children's learning involving number blocks.

programme.title: Sam Tân
programme.desc: Mae Moose yn mynd â'r plant ar antur yn y Gorllewin Gwyllt. Moose takes the children on a Wild West adventure.

programme.title: Blwi
programme.desc: Bluey pretends to run a taxi service, where her first passenger is Businessman Dad, who urgently needs to get to the airport.

programme.title: Octonots
programme.desc: Pan fydd siarc rhesog yn llyncu camera sydd gan Ceri y crwban môr, ac yna yn bygwth Ceri ei hun, mae'n rhaid i Ira a'r Octonots ddod i'w hachub. A tiger shark eats Ceri the sea turtle's camera, and then threatens Ceri herself.

programme.title: Deian a Loli
programme.desc: Mae Deian a Loli yn cael damwain yn y gegin ac yn torri gliniadur Dad! Sut maen nhw am ei drwsio? Deian and Loli have an accident in the kitchen and break Dad's laptop!

programme.title: Og y Draenog Hapus
programme.desc: Mae Beti a Gwilym wedi dychryn yn arw a mae nhw ofn y pethau brawychus. Beti and Gwilym are very scared of the scary things.

programme.title: Og y Draenog Hapus
programme.desc: Mae Beti a Gwilym wedi dychryn yn arw a mae nhw ofn y pethau brawychus. Beti and Gwilym are very scared of the scary things.

programme.title: Joni Jet
programme.desc: Mae hi'n Ddiwrnod Gwerthfawrogi'r Botiaid, ond mae Jet-boi yn awyddus i gael y sylw i gyd! It is Bot Appreciation Day, but Jet-boy wants all the attention!

programme.title: Misho
programme.desc: Teimlad o bryder sydd dan sylw yn Misho heddiw, ac mae'r Llyfrgellydd Llwyd yn neud hi'n anodd i blentyn bach ddarllen. The Llyfrgellydd Llwyd makes it difficult for a small child to read.

programme.title: Crawc a'i Ffrindiau
programme.desc: Mae'r gwencwn yn dwyn cwch Gwich ond cyn bo hir ma' nhw mewn trafferth ar afon wyllt. The weasels steal Gwich's rowing boat but soon find themselves in trouble on a fast-flowing river.

programme.title: Parc Glan Gwil
programme.desc: Mae Cai Caffi'n trefnu noson byrgyrs yn y caffi, ond mae Sioned Siop yn cael trafferth gyda'r popty a does dim modd eu coginio. Cai Caffi organises a burger night in the café.

programme.title: Odo
programme.desc: Cartwn hyfryd am gwdihw bach o'r enw Odo a'i ffrindiau yn y goedwig. A little owl called Odo and his woodland friends aim to combat the rise of anxiety in pre-school children by teaching them self-efficacy and to believe in themselves.

programme.title: Sion Y Chef
programme.desc: Siôn tries to break the world record for the biggest sandwich ever made, but it's a challenge.

programme.title: Anifeiliaid Bach y Byd
programme.desc: Dewch ar antur gyda ni i gwrdd ag anifeiliaid bach y byd. Yn y rhaglen hon y llwynog a'r wenynen sy'n hawlio'r sylw. An opportunity to get to know the fox and the honey bee.

programme.title: Pablo
programme.desc: Mae gan Pablo ei ffordd ei hun o weld y byd, ond heddiw mae swn ar y stryd yn ei ddychryn. Sut greadur ydi'r ddraig swnllyd? When Pablo is woken by banging and scraping he draws a cave to hide in, afraid of the noise dragon.

programme.title: Oli Wyn
programme.desc: The London Underground system is one of the most famous in the world. Tom, one of Oli Wyn's friends, has offered to show him how to travel on one.

programme.title: Guto Gwningen
programme.desc: Mae tad Lili yn penderfynu symud ei deulu o'r dyffryn, ond diolch i gynllun cyfrwys Guto mae'n ail feddwl. Lili's father decides to move the family out of the area but Guto changes his mind.

programme.title: Abadas
programme.desc: The Abadas are playing in the mud in the garden when Ben invites them to play another great game, the word game. They find out what today's word will be and who will be chosen to look for it.

programme.title: Ein Byd Bach Ni
programme.desc: Heddiw, awn ar antur i wlad fwyaf De America, sef Brasil. A visit to Brazil, where they speak Portuguese and where one of the most famous landmarks is the Christ the Redeemer statue.

programme.title: Pentre Papur Pop
programme.desc: Ar yr antur popwych heddiw mae Huwcyn a Help Llaw yn adeiladu parc themau anhygoel! On their latest poptastic adventure, Huwcyn and Help Llaw have built an amazing theme park!

programme.title: Dal Dy Ddannedd
programme.desc: Timau o Ysgol Ynys Wen sy'n ymuno â Pwdryn a Melys i chwarae llond trol o gemau lliwgar! Teams from Ysgol Ynys Wen join Pwdryn and Melys to play a series of candy land themed games.

programme.title: Y Pitws Bychain
programme.desc: Mae'r Pitws Bychain yn mynd i weld Syrcas Chwain ac yn gyffrous iawn - ond mae Macsen yn taro'r llwyfan ar ddamwain. The Wee Littles are going to a Flea Circus, and are very excited.

programme.title: Chwedlau Tinga Tinga
programme.sub-title: Pam Does Gan Hipo Ddim Blew?
programme.desc: There was a time when Hippo did have hair, lots of hair! She was always unbearably hot. Then one hot night while Hippo was sleeping, a spark from the fire caught the end of her hairy tail. Hippo was on fire, and she ran through the bush until she jumped in the waterhole. From then on Hippo stayed in the cool waters without a single hair on her hide.

programme.title: Ahoi!
programme.desc: Pwy fydd y môr-ladron sy'n ymuno â Ben Dant a Cadi i herio'r byd y tro 'ma? From which school will these pirates come, to join Ben Dant and Cadi for a little adventure?

programme.title: Sion Y Chef
programme.desc: Mae Siôn ac Izzy'n gwarchod Bea ond maen nhw'n tynnu gwallt o'u pennau pan mae'n crïo'n ddiddiwedd. Siôn and Izzy offer to babysit Baby Bea, but a crying baby proves to be quite a handful.

programme.title: Ein Byd Bach Ni
programme.desc: Byddwn yn teithio i Baris i ddysgu am Pierre Lallement, y dyn wnaeth greu'r beic gyda phedalau nol yn 1863. Discovering how bikes work and about the different types of bikes, such as motorbikes.

programme.title: Caban Banana Gareth yr Orangutan
programme.desc: Mi fydd Gareth yr Orangutan yn teithio ysgolion ledled Cymru yn trafod pob math o bynciau. Wythnos yma, Gwyliau ydi'r pwnc trafod. This week, holidays is the topic of discussion.

programme.title: Blero Yn Mynd I Ocido
programme.desc: Mae'r igian sydd ar Blero'n achosi tirlithriad. Fydd e'n gallu dod o hyd i'w ffordd adre? Blero's hiccups cause a landslide. Can he stop and find his way home?

programme.title: Byd Tad-cu
